data: Your next Heavy Melee attack against an enemy deals increased damage.
While you are below 50% health, you gain stat bonuses for a duration and existing debuffs on you are reduced.
While reloading, pressing Reload during the highlighted portion will instantly finish your reload and grant you Fire Rate, Bullet Lifesteal and Move Speed.
Launch yourself high into the air and grant yourself a Barrier. While in the air, you can use the active again to drop down faster.
Cannot be used for 5s if attacked by enemy Hero.
Reset the cooldown of all your abilities and restore all your charges.
Bonus Spirit Power for Charged Abilities
Reduces the effect of enemy applied healing reduction.
Walking through a cosmic veil grants you Stealth, Heal and increased Move Speed.
When the target takes spirit damage, they have their Move Speed reduced.
Your bullets build up to a Silence. Victims are immune to the build up for 10s after silence expires.
After you Dash-Jump, the next ability you use within 7s will have bonus Range, Duration, and Spirit Power.
Apply a Stun after 2s. Stun duration is increased against airborne targets.
Increases the target's gravity for the duration of the stun.
Imbue an ability with permanent Spirit Power. When that ability is used, gain bonus Move Speed and maintain full speed while attacking.
Deal additional Weapon Damage when in close range to your target.
Your bullets have a chance to be empowered, causing them to deal bonus weapon damage on hit.
Your Weapon Damage increases as you take sustained damage.
Grant Regen and Sprint Speed to the target. Gets dispelled if you take damage from enemy players or objectives. Can be self-cast.
Gain Spirit Lifesteal and Spirit Power.
Become Stealthed. Whenever you take damage while Stealthed you get briefly revealed.
Attacking or using an ability will end your stealth and start an ambush, temporarily granting you bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Melee Damage.
Heals a target allied hero and yourself for a percentage of Max Health. Once while healing, you can Pull the target towards you. Can be self-cast.
Slows movement of enemy target. Also Silences their movement-based items and abilities.
Does not affect target's stamina usage.
When you deal spirit damage to enemies, you also reduce their Fire Rate.
Throw a flask that explodes on contact, creating an area that does increasing spirit damage per second and reduces enemy Bullet Resist.
Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals bonus weapon damage.
When an enemy uses an ability within 32mm range from you, store one Restoration Stack.
Consume all stacks to heal yourself and replenish up to 3 stamina based on how many stacks you have.
When in close range to your target, gain Weapon Damage and your bullets apply a Movement Slow.
Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.
Gain bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Spirit Lifesteal by charging up when shooting enemy heroes.

You enter a void state and become untargetable and invincible for a short duration, during which you float slowly and cannot perform actions. Afterwards you gain Spirit Power, Move Speed, and Spirit Resist.
Summon a Magic Carpet that will fly you away. While flying you are immune to slows and doing any action will dismiss the carpet.
Cannot use abilities while the carpet is being summoned.
Upon casting an ultimate ability gain a Barrier and temporary Spirit Power.
Inflict damage over time to a target, dealing damage based on their current health.
Decay's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.
Temporarily suppress negative status effects and become immune to Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root, and Disarm.
Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept.
Gain bonus Move Speed and Slow Resistance.
Removes the Move Speed penalty while shooting.
Your bullets build up a Bleed on enemies, causing them to lose a percentage of their Max Health over time. Also applies Healing Reduction on the bleeding target.
Your next bullet will heal you based on what target you hit.
Landing a Headshot will reduce their Bullet and Spirit Resist and applies Healing Reduction.
Dash forward, gaining slow resistance while leaving a flaming trail that deals spirit damage over time.
Hold [W] while active to dash farther.
Enable 2 Ability Charges with 14s Recharge time
Weapon hits build up a burning effect, dealing spirit damage over time.
Abilities refresh to the base burn duration and weapon hits extend it.
Channel an expanding storm cloud around you that damages all enemies within its radius. Enemies do not take damage when they are out of line-of-sight.
+55% Bullet Resist while channeling Storm Cloud
Throw a stake that tethers enemies to the location where the stake lands. Enemy movement is restricted to the length of the tether.
Your crow familiar deals impact damage, reduces their bullet resist and applies a bleed that deals damage based on the target's current health.

Use your scoped rifle to fire a powerful shot over long distances. Deal only partial damage until fully charged after 1.0s of being scoped. Does bonus damage to enemies with less than 50% health remaining. Landing a killing blow on a player with Assassinate grants you bonus weapon damage.

Create a tether that drains enemy health over time and heals you. Target must be in line of sight and within max range to drain. You can shoot and use other abilities during the drain, but your move speed is reduced.
to give health to friendly Heroes.
Enables and Grants +2 Charges. Increases spirit scaling.
Sacrifice some of your health to launch blood shards that apply a stack of Malice. Each stack slows the victim and increases the damage they take from you. The slow effect decreases over time.
Swaps health levels with an enemy target. There is a minimum health percentage that enemies can be brought down to and a minimum amount of health received based on victims current health.
On cast, +60 Spirit Power, +40% Fire Rate and +50% Spirit Resistance for 8s.
Drain health from nearby enemies, dealing spirit damage over time and healing for a portion of the damage dealt.
+2m Radius and +18.0 DPS with improved Spirit scaling
Temporarily boosts your fire rate and deal bonus spirit damage
Unlimited Ammo and Increased Scaling on Spirit Damage Per Bullet
Lift an enemy hero into the air and then slam them towards the target location.
+1.5s Debuff Duration and +6m Throw and Cast Range
Deploy a turret that shoots enemies, dealing spirit damage over time. The turret expires after a limited lifetime.
Turrets deal reduced damage to troopers and objectives.
+25% Turret Fire Rate and +12s Turret Lifetime
Charge up a powerful shot of time energy, dealing spirit damage and applying a Time-Stop to enemies hit. The damage dealt increases with weapon damage. Move speed is increased while charging.
While in the air and charging, to timeslow your movement.
+2s Charge Hold Duration and +55% Damage Scaling
Release an energy pulse that travels along the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying knockup.
On Hit: -15% Bullet Resist and -24% Move Speed for 4s
Briefly become untargetable while teleporting to the target location. Restores stamina upon use.
While channeling, restore health over time to you and any allies nearby.
You can dash and melee without breaking the channel.
Aura provides +4m Move Speed during channel
Full move and ability use and additionally heals +2.5% of Max Health per second
Create a singularity in your hands, dealing spirit damage over time, applying stun, and pulling in nearby enemies.
Throw a grenade that explodes in a cloud of freezing ice that heals allies and applies spirit damage and move speed reduction to enemies.
-10 Cooldown and debuff now freezes Stamina Regen
+2m Radius. Damage and Heal Spirit Scaling increased.
Target yourself or a Hero to freeze the air and create an impenetrable dome around them. While in the dome, allies gain rapid regeneration and enemies are slowed.
Objectives becomes Invulnerable and Frozen under Frozen Shelter
Purges non-ult debuffs for you and your allies.
+65 Health Regen and increased Spirit Scaling

Throw a dagger that damages and sleeps the target. Sleeping targets wake up shortly after being damaged. Throwing a Dagger does not break your invisibility. Sleep Dagger does not interrupt enemies' channeling abilities.
-10.0% Bullet Resist Reduction for 6.0s on wake-up
-40% Move and Dash Speed for 3s on wake-up
Fade out of sight, becoming invisible and gaining sprint speed. Attacking removes invisibility, but using items does not. Close enemies can see through your invisibility.
Shooting a target increases your bullet damage on that target. Gain one stack per bullet hit, three if the hit is a headshot.
40.0 Spirit damage and 12% slow for 2s to target every 20 stacks
Enter a flurry, firing your weapon at nearby enemies with perfect accuracy and added Bullet Damage.
Charge up a powerful shot that pierces through enemies. Hold Ability 1 or to hold the shot.
Improved damage scaling and -3s Charge Delay

Throw out a trap that begins to arm itself. Once armed, the trap will trigger when an enemy enters its radius, applying Curse and Movement Slow that interrupts, Silences, Disarms, and prevents item usage.
Hit the trap with a Charged Shot to detonate early with increased radius.
Deal damage to nearby enemies and heal yourself based on the damage done. Heal is stronger against enemy heroes.
Adds a debuff to enemies that lets Mo & Krill deal +15% Damage to them. Stacks and lasts 16s.
Burrow underground, moving faster, and gaining spirit and bullet armor. Damage from enemy heroes will reduce the speed bonus.
When you jump out, deal spirit damage, slow, and knockup.
Hold the target in place, stunning them and dealing damage during the channel. If they die during, or within 3 seconds of Combo ending, you permanently gain max health.
+0.7s Duration and +40.0 Damage Per Second and increased scaling
Active: Leap forward, dealing spirit damage to the first enemy hero. If they are below the kill threshold, execute them instead.
Finishing an enemy with Killing Blow lets you recast for 16s
Passive: Damaging enemies fills you with rage. While at full rage, Shiv gains increased damage and unlocks special properties on his other abilities.
Connect with a nearby ally to gain bonuses, replicated healing, and ignore the move speed penalty while shooting.
Receive 50% of Bonuses with no connection
Turn yourself into impervious stone and smash into the ground, stunning and damaging enemies nearby. Heals you for a percentage of your max health.
+0.75s Stun Duration and increased Damage spirit scaling
Grab an ally and take flight with them. Drop your ally to cause an explosion, dealing spirit damage. You and your ally gain increased Outgoing Damage when flying ends.
Cooldown reduced by 30% when used on allies.
Taking damage briefly disables using the ability.
While lifted, your ally cannot attack and deals -20% damage.
On Fly End : 300 Barrier to Ivy and ally that scales with Spirit
After charging for 2s, release pulses that damage enemies and heal you based on the damage done.
While channeling Last Stand you have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist.

Become infused with Yamato's shadow soul. After an initial invincible transformation your abilities are refreshed and are 60% faster. You gain immunity to negative status effects and have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist.
When you get a hero kill, you heal and the duration is extended.
Stomp the ground beneath you, damaging enemies in front of you. If you perform Ground Strike while airborne, you quickly dive towards the ground. Damage grows slower after 25m.
Struck enemies are knocked up and slowed by 40% for 3s
Damage Per Meter +120% and improved scaling

Focus on enemies to connect whips to them. After channeling, connected enemies are lifted and stunned then slammed into the ground. Your victims and any enemies in the landing zone will be damaged and slowed.
Press to throw connected enemies early. Enemies that are not in line of sight or go out of range during the latch time will not be grabbed.

Encase the target in a cube of restorative goo that protects from damage, and increases health regen. Target is unable to take any new actions while cubed. Can be used on self. Press Jump / mantle to escape early.
Increases Move Speed and Stamina Recovery
Removes all non-ult Debuffs and -20.0s Cooldown
Materialize a fist in the world that punches everyone in the area, applying knockup.
Punching an enemy deals melee damage and applies slow.
You and your allies have increased Air Control.
-14.0s Cooldown and now deals Heavy Melee Damage
Morph into a large goo ball that deals damage and stuns enemies on impact. The ball grants large amounts of Bullet and Spirit resist, bounces off walls and can double jump.
+7s Duration, +0.3s Stun Duration, and +0.2 Spirit Scaling
Launch a sentient cloak that travels forward and damages enemies. You can press Ability 2 to teleport to its location.
Escape into your suitcase. When the duration ends, deal spirit damage to nearby enemies. Duration can be ended early by performing any action.
-32% Move Speed and Fire Rate for 4.0s
Applies damage over time to enemies nearby.
Affliction's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.
Infest an enemy with fire scarabs, stealing life from them and causing them to deal reduced damage.
Target a location on the minimap. After a brief wait, teleport to that location. Taking damage during the wait period causes the teleport to be interrupted.
+3m Move Speed and +20% Fire Rate for 12s
